topic.title: Private Learning and Adaptive Privacy Budgets
topic.overview: Private learning limits what a released model or training procedure reveals about sensitive data. This cluster includes differential privacy, private tuning, individualized budgets, and mechanisms for modifying gradient clipping or sampling. It also contains earlier cryptographic approaches, which protect information through a different formal mechanism.
topic.whyItMatters: Privacy is a quantitative constraint with consequences for accuracy and computation. Tuning a private system can itself consume privacy, and a uniform budget may not reflect different participants’ preferences or risks.
topic.evolution: Early representatives study private regression, reinforcement learning, and online prediction. Later work makes deep learning and hyperparameter tuning practical under formal privacy accounting. Recent approaches personalize budgets or adapt clipping from signals already produced by the training mechanism. These refinements seek better utility without silently spending additional information about individuals.
openQuestions: How should individualized guarantees be communicated and audited across repeated training runs?
Which adaptive training decisions can reuse existing private information without extra exposure?

papers.title: Initialization Matters: Privacy-Utility Analysis of Overparameterized Neural Networks

papers.title: Label Robust and Differentially Private Linear Regression: Computational and Statistical Efficiency
papers.tldr: A private regression algorithm combines full-batch updates and adaptive clipping to achieve efficient learning despite adversarial response corruption.

papers.title: Offline Reinforcement Learning with Differential Privacy
papers.tldr: Differentially private offline-RL algorithms achieve instance-dependent learning guarantees, with theory and simulations suggesting almost no utility loss for medium-size datasets.

papers.title: Optimal privacy guarantees for a relaxed threat model: Addressing sub-optimal adversaries in differentially private machine learning
papers.tldr: The paper characterizes membership-inference privacy when attackers have related or partial data but lack the exact training database.

papers.title: Optimal Unbiased Randomizers for Regression with Label Differential Privacy
papers.tldr: Privately estimated label distributions guide regression randomizers that improve privacy–utility tradeoffs by managing bias and variance.

papers.title: Post-processing Private Synthetic Data for Improving Utility on Selected Measures
papers.tldr: Optimized resampling improves private synthetic data on user-selected utility measures while preserving privacy guarantees and dataset quality.

papers.title: Practical Differentially Private Hyperparameter Tuning with Subsampling
papers.tldr: Private hyperparameter tuning on a random data subset, followed by extrapolation, improves the tested privacy–utility tradeoff while targeting lower compute costs.

papers.title: Privacy Auditing with One (1) Training Run
papers.tldr: A privacy auditing scheme uses independently varied training examples to obtain meaningful empirical privacy lower bounds from one training run.

papers.title: Private Everlasting Prediction

papers.title: Scaling Up Differentially Private LASSO Regularized Logistic Regression via Faster Frank-Wolfe Iterations
papers.tldr: Sparse-aware Frank-Wolfe iterations reduce the training cost of differentially private regression, with reported speedups reaching 2,200 times.

papers.title: Sparsity-Preserving Differentially Private Training of Large Embedding Models
papers.tldr: DP-FEST and DP-AdaFEST preserve sparse gradients during private embedding-model training, reporting million-fold gradient-size reductions with comparable accuracy.

papers.title: Training Private Models That Know What They Don’t Know
papers.tldr: Private selective classifiers can recover non-private performance in experiments, but stronger privacy demands substantially more abstention.

papers.title: Unified Enhancement of Privacy Bounds for Mixture Mechanisms via $f$-Differential Privacy
papers.tldr: New f-differential privacy tools sharpen shuffling bounds and numerically indicate a privacy benefit from random initialization in one-step private gradient descent.

papers.title: Unleashing the Power of Randomization in Auditing Differentially Private ML
papers.tldr: Randomized canaries, reusable model tests, and correlation-aware confidence intervals improve the sample efficiency of differential-privacy audits.

papers.title: User-Level Differential Privacy With Few Examples Per User
papers.tldr: The paper develops generic user-level private learning methods for settings where each user contributes only a few examples.

papers.title: A New Linear Scaling Rule for Private Adaptive Hyperparameter Optimization
papers.tldr: An adaptive method uses inexpensive private tuning trials to select and scale hyperparameters, achieving strong benchmark results while accounting for search privacy costs.

papers.title: Auditing Private Prediction
papers.tldr: A framework for auditing private prediction shows how poisoning and query control affect experimentally demonstrated privacy leakage.

papers.title: Beyond the Calibration Point: Mechanism Comparison in Differential Privacy
papers.tldr: Δ-divergence compares privacy mechanisms beyond one calibration pair by quantifying worst-case excess vulnerability.

papers.title: Bounding the Excess Risk for Linear Models Trained on Marginal-Preserving, Differentially-Private, Synthetic Data
papers.tldr: The paper bounds the extra empirical error of linear models trained on private synthetic data that preserves low-order marginals.

papers.title: CaPS: Collaborative and Private Synthetic Data Generation from Distributed Sources
papers.tldr: CaPS combines secure multi-party computation and differential privacy to generate synthetic tabular data collaboratively without a trusted raw-data aggregator.

papers.title: Differentially Private Bias-Term Fine-tuning of Foundation Models
papers.tldr: DP-BiTFiT privately fine-tunes only bias parameters, matching reported leading private accuracy while substantially reducing time and memory costs.

papers.title: Differentially Private Decentralized Learning with Random Walks
papers.tldr: Pairwise privacy formulas reveal how network structure shapes privacy in random-walk learning, with advantages over gossip methods for nearby nodes.

papers.title: Differentially Private Domain Adaptation with Theoretical Guarantees
papers.tldr: Two theoretically supported algorithms adapt public labeled data to a private target domain under differential privacy.

papers.title: Differentially Private Post-Processing for Fair Regression
papers.tldr: The method privately estimates prediction distributions and remaps them toward a shared distribution, with an analyzed fairness–error trade-off.

papers.title: Differentially Private Sum-Product Networks
papers.tldr: A differentially private sum-product network supports both classification and synthetic data generation, with reported gains in training stability and generated-data utility.

papers.title: Differentially Private Synthetic Data via Foundation Model APIs 2: Text
papers.tldr: Aug-PE generates differentially private synthetic text using only language-model APIs, with utility competitive with private fine-tuning in the reported benchmarks.

papers.title: DPZero: Private Fine-Tuning of Language Models without Backpropagation
papers.tldr: DPZero combines private fine-tuning with forward-pass-only optimization and achieves nearly dimension-independent theoretical rates.

papers.title: Improved Bounds for Pure Private Agnostic Learning: Item-Level and User-Level Privacy
papers.tldr: The paper improves bounds on the number of users needed for pure private agnostic learning under item-level and user-level privacy.

papers.title: Locally Differentially Private Decentralized Stochastic Bilevel Optimization with Guaranteed Convergence Accuracy
papers.tldr: A decentralized bilevel algorithm avoids nested communication loops and provides privacy with accurate convergence while quantifying the effect on convergence speed.

papers.title: Noise-Aware Algorithm for Heterogeneous Differentially Private Federated Learning
papers.tldr: Robust-HDP estimates client-update noise to improve federated learning with heterogeneous privacy requirements and data sizes.

papers.title: Optimal Differentially Private Model Training with Public Data
papers.tldr: The paper characterizes optimal private-learning error rates with public data and develops algorithms that improve constants and empirical performance.

papers.title: Position: Considerations for Differentially Private Learning with Large-Scale Public Pretraining
papers.tldr: This position paper questions the privacy framing, benchmarks, and outsourcing implications of using large public pretrained models for private learning.

papers.title: PrE-Text: Training Language Models on Private Federated Data in the Age of LLMs
papers.tldr: PrE-Text generates differentially private synthetic text that improves evaluated model performance while sharply reducing client training and communication costs.

papers.title: Privacy Attacks in Decentralized Learning
papers.tldr: A reconstruction attack shows that decentralized learning participants can recover private data from users beyond their immediate neighbors.

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Data Release Leveraging Optimal Transport and Particle Gradient Descent
papers.tldr: PrivPGD uses optimal transport and particle gradient descent for scalable private tabular-data synthesis with support for domain-specific constraints.

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Instructions for Aligning Large Language Models
papers.tldr: Differentially private synthetic instructions replace sensitive user data while retaining strong alignment performance in experiments.

papers.title: Private and Federated Stochastic Convex Optimization: Efficient Strategies for Centralized Systems
papers.tldr: The paper develops differentially private federated convex optimization methods with optimal convergence and linear computational complexity across server trust settings.

papers.title: Private Gradient Descent for Linear Regression: Tighter Error Bounds and Instance-Specific Uncertainty Estimation
papers.tldr: A distributional analysis of private gradient descent yields linear dimension dependence in sample complexity and dataset-adaptive confidence intervals.

papers.title: Private Heterogeneous Federated Learning Without a Trusted Server Revisited: Error-Optimal and Communication-Efficient Algorithms for Convex Losses
papers.tldr: New federated algorithms achieve optimal private-learning error bounds for heterogeneous data and convex losses with improved communication and computation.

papers.title: Private Truly-Everlasting Robust-Prediction
papers.tldr: The paper extends everlasting private prediction with poisoning robustness, a relaxed privacy definition, and more efficient constructions for two prediction classes.

papers.title: Provable Privacy with Non-Private Pre-Processing
papers.tldr: A privacy-accounting framework bounds the additional cost of non-private, data-dependent preprocessing before differentially private algorithms.

papers.title: Rényi Pufferfish Privacy: General Additive Noise Mechanisms and Privacy Amplification by Iteration via Shift Reduction Lemmas
papers.tldr: Rényi Pufferfish privacy broadens additive-noise mechanisms and provides privacy amplification guarantees for contractive noisy iterations.

papers.title: Shifted Interpolation for Differential Privacy

papers.title: The Privacy Power of Correlated Noise in Decentralized Learning

papers.title: Unveiling Privacy, Memorization, and Input Curvature Links
papers.tldr: The paper derives bounds linking memorization, input loss curvature, and differential privacy, supported by experiments on CIFAR and ImageNet.

papers.title: Attack-Aware Noise Calibration for Differential Privacy
papers.tldr: Calibrating privacy noise directly to a specified attack risk can improve model accuracy while preserving that risk level.

papers.title: Auditing Privacy Mechanisms via Label Inference Attacks
papers.tldr: Reconstruction advantage measures compare label privacy schemes by the extra inference ability they give an attacker beyond the features alone.

papers.title: Banded Square Root Matrix Factorization for Differentially Private Model Training
papers.tldr: BSR makes matrix factorization for private model training inexpensive while retaining performance comparable to leading methods.

papers.title: Certified Machine Unlearning via Noisy Stochastic Gradient Descent

papers.title: Credit Attribution and Stable Compression

papers.title: Differential Privacy in Scalable General Kernel Learning via $K$-means Nystr{\"o}m Random Features
papers.tldr: Private Nyström approximations support scalable learning and data representations for general kernels with theoretical and experimental evaluation.

papers.title: Differentially Private Reinforcement Learning with Self-Play
papers.tldr: The paper develops trajectory-level privacy definitions and a provably efficient private learning algorithm for two-player zero-sum episodic games.

papers.title: Differentially Private Stochastic Gradient Descent with Fixed-Size Minibatches: Tighter RDP Guarantees with or without Replacement
papers.tldr: Tighter privacy accounting strengthens the case for fixed-size minibatches in DP-SGD, alongside their memory and observed gradient-variance benefits.

papers.title: DOPPLER: Differentially Private Optimizers with Low-pass Filter for Privacy Noise Reduction
papers.tldr: DOPPLER uses low-pass filtering to reduce the impact of privacy noise and improve private training while preserving privacy guarantees.

papers.title: Efficient and Private Marginal Reconstruction with Local Non-Negativity

papers.title: Faster Algorithms for User-Level Private Stochastic Convex Optimization

papers.title: Federated Online Prediction from Experts with Differential Privacy: Separations and Regret Speed-ups

papers.title: Instance-Specific Asymmetric Sensitivity in Differential Privacy
papers.tldr: A private-estimation framework uses dataset-specific asymmetry and a flexible bias–variance tradeoff to improve estimates efficiently.

papers.title: Langevin Unlearning: A New Perspective of Noisy Gradient Descent for Machine Unlearning
papers.tldr: Langevin unlearning unifies private training and certified approximate forgetting through noisy gradient descent, with savings over retraining and support for repeated requests.

papers.title: Nearly Tight Black-Box Auditing of Differentially Private Machine Learning

papers.title: Noise-Aware Differentially Private Regression via Meta-Learning

papers.title: Oracle-Efficient Differentially Private Learning with Public Data

papers.title: Pre-training Differentially Private Models with Limited Public Data

papers.title: Privacy without Noisy Gradients: Slicing Mechanism for Generative Model Training

papers.title: Private Online Learning via Lazy Algorithms

papers.title: Unified Mechanism-Specific Amplification by Subsampling and Group Privacy Amplification

papers.title: A Certified Unlearning Approach without Access to Source Data

papers.title: Certification for Differentially Private Prediction in Gradient-Based Training

papers.title: Differential Privacy Under Class Imbalance: Methods and Empirical Insights

papers.title: Empirical Privacy Variance

papers.title: Going Deeper into Locally Differentially Private Graph Neural Networks
papers.tldr: UPGNET improves private graph learning by addressing the effects of feature dimension and neighborhood size on utility.

papers.title: It’s My Data Too: Private ML for Datasets with Multi-User Training Examples

papers.title: Leveraging Per-Instance Privacy for Machine Unlearning

papers.title: Leveraging Randomness in Model and Data Partitioning for Privacy Amplification

papers.title: Noisy SIGNSGD Is More Differentially Private Than You (Might) Think

papers.title: Online Differentially Private Conformal Prediction for Uncertainty Quantification

papers.title: PCEvolve: Private Contrastive Evolution for Synthetic Dataset Generation via Few-Shot Private Data and Generative APIs

papers.title: Privacy Amplification by Structured Subsampling for Deep Differentially Private Time Series Forecasting
papers.tldr: Analyzing structured time-series sampling enables forecasting models with sound event-level and user-level differential privacy guarantees.

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Convex Optimization: Balancing Partial-Participation and Efficiency via Noise Cancellation

papers.title: Scalable Private Partition Selection via Adaptive Weighting

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Differentially Private Language Models

papers.title: Towards Trustworthy Federated Learning with Untrusted Participants

papers.title: Convex Approximation of Two-Layer ReLU Networks for Hidden State Differential Privacy

papers.title: Differentially Private Bilevel Optimization: Efficient Algorithms with Near-Optimal Rates

papers.title: Differentially Private High-dimensional Variable Selection via Integer Programming

papers.title: GeoClip: Geometry-Aware Clipping for Differentially Private SGD

papers.title: How Well Can Differential Privacy Be Audited in One Run?

papers.title: Mitigating the Privacy–Utility Trade-off in Decentralized Federated Learning via f-Differential Privacy

papers.title: Multi-Class Support Vector Machine with Differential Privacy

papers.title: On the Sample Complexity of Differentially Private Policy Optimization

papers.title: Online Locally Differentially Private Conformal Prediction via Binary Inquiries

papers.title: PREAMBLE: Private and Efficient Aggregation via Block Sparse Vectors

papers.title: Private Evolution Converges

papers.title: Private Online Learning against an Adaptive Adversary: Realizable and Agnostic Settings

papers.title: Private Zeroth-Order Optimization with Public Data

papers.title: Rewind-to-Delete: Certified Machine Unlearning for Nonconvex Functions

papers.title: Sequentially Auditing Differential Privacy

papers.title: Setting $\varepsilon$ is not the Issue in Differential Privacy

papers.title: Sketched Gaussian Mechanism for Private Federated Learning

papers.title: The Gaussian Mixing Mechanism: Renyi Differential Privacy via Gaussian Sketches

papers.title: Accuracy-First Rényi Differential Privacy and Post-Processing Immunity

papers.title: Differentially Private Synthetic Data via APIs 4: Tabular Data

papers.title: DP-KFC: Data-Free Preconditioning for Privacy-Preserving Deep Learning

papers.title: Efficient DP-SGD for LLMs with Randomized Clipping

papers.title: Efficient Public Verification of Private ML via Regularization

papers.title: Eliminating Solution Bias in Differentially Private Optimization

papers.title: FIBER: A Differentially Private Optimizer with Filter-Aware Innovation Bias Correction

papers.title: Improved Bounds for Private and Robust Alignment

papers.title: LAPRAS : Learning-Augmented PRivate Answering for linear query Streams.

papers.title: OptiFluence: Principled Design of Privacy Canaries

papers.title: Position: Privacy Is a Claim, Not a Property of Synthetic Data

papers.title: PRISM: Gauge-Invariant Tangent-Space Differentially Private LoRA

papers.title: Privacy Amplification in Differentially Private Zeroth-Order Optimization with Hidden States

papers.title: Private and Stable Test-time Adaptation with Differential Privacy

papers.title: Private Learning with Public Feature Conditioning

papers.title: SlaClip: Gradient Norm Slacks can be Indicator for Adaptive Clipping in DP-SGD

papers.title: Understanding Private Learning From Feature Perspective

papers.title: Unlearning with Asymmetric Sources: Improved Unlearning-Utility Trade-off with Public Data
